nodes.summary: The TATA AIG Bharat Griha Raksha Policy provides coverage for home building and home contents against various perils. The policy includes definitions of home building, use for residence, sum insured, what we pay, loss of rent and rent for alternative accommodation, home contents cover, optional covers, add-ons, exclusions, and policyholder's obligations. The policy covers physical loss or damage to or destruction of the general contents of the home caused by an Insured Event, and pays the cost of repairs, replacement, or repair of damaged items. The policy also provides personal accident cover and allows policyholders to opt for add-ons. However, the policy excludes certain events and losses, and policyholders have certain obligations to fulfill.
